blocks.intent: symbolic constant, addition, subtraction and scalar

attempts.candidate:
sketch:
    have n N+
    have c R
    have f,g fn(k Z) R
    sum(1,n,fn(k Z) R {c}) = n*c
    sum(1,n,fn(k Z) R {f(k)+g(k)}) = sum(1,n,f)+sum(1,n,g)
    sum(1,n,fn(k Z) R {f(k)-g(k)}) = sum(1,n,f)-sum(1,n,g)
    sum(1,n,fn(k Z) R {c*f(k)}) = c*sum(1,n,f)
